recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-panel action sequence featuring a single subject in different poses across four vertical red-gradient segments, topped by a large, two-tiered typographic header on an off-white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Four vertical panels containing sequential action poses
High-contrast black typography against a cream header
Vibrant red-to-orange gradient background within the image panels
Subject's grey and black attire contrasting with the warm background
coreInvariants: Vertical white dividers between image panels
Consistent lighting across all four subject instances

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject occupies the bottom two-thirds of the frame, divided into four equal vertical slices.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold black name in the center-top of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top title down to the left-most panel, then scans right through the dance sequence.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant off-white space at the top provides breathing room for the metadata and titles.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm red and orange gradients in the lower panels.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the primary artist name and trousers.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Salmon red for the secondary title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the lower half; low saturation and high value (cream) in the upper half.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight for the primary name
Italicized, high-contrast serif/sans hybrid for the top title
Wide tracking for the metadata at the very top
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning on the bold black text to create a solid block effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold condensed sans-serif paired with a softer, italicized display face for contrast in weight and mood.

preserve: The heavy condensed block of the artist name
The italicized slant of the top title
avoid: Overlapping the text onto the image panels

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, flat-terminal look of the primary name.
Captures the mid-century bold italic feel of the secondary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a four-panel vertical layout. Each panel features a man in a grey cardigan and black pants in a different dance pose. The background of the panels is a red-to-orange gradient. Separate panels with thin white lines. Above the panels, leave a large cream-colored header area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the cream header, place a line of salmon-red bold italic text. Below that, place a larger line of extra-bold black condensed sans-serif text. At the very top, add small, wide-tracked technical metadata in a light sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text black and condensed?
Is the background of the panels a red gradient?

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean separation between the four panels
Verify the salmon-red color of the top title
Ensure the black text is the most visually heavy element
Confirm the cream header is free of photographic elements
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Action Sequence + Bold Condensed Header + Warm Gradient Panels
